note: Slice B expansion. User-voiced register, grounded strictly in capabilities T04 and T05 actually document. Every answering document below was verified to exist in the tenant corpus before the row was written — none is assumed.
label_basis: agent, two passes. Pass A matched the question's topic to a document path; pass B read the named document and confirmed it contains the answer. Both were run by the same agent, so this is agreement between two METHODS, not independent labelling, and it is not owner validation.
